g.text: Requests an advance for a supplier: amount,
Only when the advance covers 100% of the
invoice; may correct the valor contable
The leader or accounting crosses the invoice
against pending advances in the same bag
Gerencia or Tesorería can apply adjustments
Creates the cash box, assigns custodians,
Spends: a supplier invoice marked as petty
cash in the billing inbox, or a physical receipt
Approves, rejects or returns to any stage
